entries.accessMode: station-level direct payment at the car-park payment terminal

policy: APCOA publishes 0.45 EUR/kWh specifically for the Neumarkt Leipzig location. The price is attached only to this exact station and MUST NOT be propagated to other APCOA locations. Other German APCOA pages confirm QR/ad-hoc availability but do not expose a reproducible charging price, and foreign APCOA tariffs are excluded.
